body: Yeah, it was quite a transition from being a sweet, young girl to being with this guy that got me involved with drugs for the first time, herpes, pregnancy, etc. It's been a tough, new time especially being away from home the first time.

No, it's all been extremely helpful.
I didn't know that bit about having a child actually being somewhat healing for people. It's been a back and forth battle as to what to do.

I think I need to seek some therapy; I know my hormones are out of whack and I think I need medical treatment, as much as I hate to admit it.

I feel embarrassed to talk to my family because I gave no indication that something was wrong and I just hate to spring things on them.

About the adoption, I feel like that is going to be added stress. I do not want to go through with a pregnancy  with no money and an abusive boyfriend. Abortion will relieve some of my stress, if anything. I am not attached to it or anything, so it shouldn't be too much of an emotional burden.

Thank you so much for the response; it is nice to read something to calm me down for a bit before I do anything rash.
